body: There is several maps that are great and there is several maps that are unwanted.  Several servers do this so its not new but there could be a voting system where after the maps you play it could say 'Did you like this map? /y for yes or /n for no.  There you can set a number of n that would suggest removing that map from avicus!

replies.author: jracer15
replies.body: Well I guess this idea can be changed for something else but just becasue one server does something doesn't automatically mean we shouldn't do it.  We don't use gamemode like survival games because so many other servers use it but so what?  You can just have a gamemode and be good at it.  No one plays Elimination, it was made to have an original Survival Games but if we had a survival games and we could have our own spin on it.  My point is you don't have to have an orignal gamemode, you can just be good at the one you have, IMO.
